name: How long does garage drywall installation usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does garage drywall installation usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a typical garage, the timeline is often **one to three days**, depending on size, finish level, and whether old material must be removed first. Drying time between coats of compound can extend the project if a smoother finish is requested.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most garage drywall jobs take 1–3 days, but finishing and drying time can stretch that longer. Removal of damaged drywall or extra detailing can add more time.
